title: Evaluation at the quantifier-prefix leaf
statement: For every finite Boolean quantifier prefix $q$, CNF formula $\varphi$, and natural number $S$, the valuation predicate at depth $|q|$ is equivalent to the matrix $\varphi$ evaluating to true under the assignment encoded by $S$ at that depth.
